Summary of work so far:

**Completed:**
- Read and analyzed `glom/reduction.py` (Fold, Sum, Flatten, Merge have __repr__)
- Read and analyzed `glom/core.py` (Coalesce, Inspect, Call, TType, Check, Path, Literal, Spec, etc.)
- Read and analyzed `glom/mutation.py` (Assign class exists but lacks __repr__)
- Read and analyzed `glom/cli.py` (currently uses ast.literal_eval, needs python-full support)
- Read and analyzed `glom/__init__.py` (current exports)

**Pending/In Progress:**
1. [R4] Add `__repr__` to Coalesce class in core.py (edit attempt failed due to text mismatch)
2. [R5] Add `__repr__` to Assign class and assign function in mutation.py
3. [R6] Coalesce __repr__ (same as R4)
4. [R7] Ensure all public specifiers have `__repr__` (Check needs one, others may need review)
5. [R2] Expose Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT as public API
6. [R3] Expose Invoke publicly, handle constants vs consts
7. [R1] Update CLI to accept Python-full specifications

I still need to:
- Search for Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke in the codebase
- Fix the Coalesce __repr__ implementation
- Implement Assign __repr__
- Update __init__.py exports
- Update cli.py for python-full support
- Handle constants/consts backward compatibility
